CFML Language Reference: Functions

Trim

Removes spaces, tabs and line breaks from both ends of a string.

Category

String functions

Syntax

Trim(string)

Parameters

string
The string to trim.

Returns

The trimmed string. Spaces inside the string are left alone.

Usage

Always trim form input before checking or storing it: a field holding a lone space is not empty to Len, but it is not much of a name either. LTrim and RTrim trim one end only.

Example

Opens the example in a new window. The example runs on this server, so it only works when you browse from the server itself (127.0.0.1).
<CFPARAM NAME="URL.Name" DEFAULT="   Grace Hopper   ">
<CFOUTPUT>
<P>You typed [#URL.Name#] (#Len(URL.Name)# characters).</P>
<P>Trimmed: [#Trim(URL.Name)#] (#Len(Trim(URL.Name))# characters).</P>
<CFIF Len(Trim(URL.Name)) EQ 0><P><B>Please enter a name!</B></P></CFIF>
</CFOUTPUT>
<FORM ACTION="trim.cfm" METHOD="GET">
Name: <INPUT TYPE="Text" NAME="Name"> <INPUT TYPE="Submit" VALUE="Trim it">
</FORM>

See also

LTrim, RTrim, Len, StripCR
